statement.name: getProcess
statement.sql:
Select * from fact_process_instance process with (NOLOCK) inner join fact_activity_instance activity with (NOLOCK) on Process.Process_Instance_id=activity.Process_Instance_id
order by process.Process_instance_id for XMl AUTO

statement.name: getContainerXml
statement.sql:
Select 1 as Tag, NULL as Parent, ContainerXmls.Container_XML as [ContainerXmls!1!ContainerXml!xmltext], PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID as [ContainerXmls!1!Id] from fact_process_instance ContainerXmls with (NOLOCK)
isnull(Container_XML,'') <> ''
Union All
Select 1 as Tag, NULL as Parent, activity.Container_XML as [ContainerXmls!1!ContainerXml!xmltext], activity.Activity_Definition_id as Id from fact_process_instance Process with (NOLOCK) inner join fact_activity_instance activity with (NOLOCK) on Process.Process_Instance_id=activity.Process_Instance_id
isnull(activity.Container_XML,'') <> ''
For XML EXPLICIT

statement.name: getDefinitions
statement.sql:
Select 1 as Tag, NULL as Parent, process.PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID as [process!1!PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID], process.IS_TEAM_ENABLED as [process!1!IS_TEAM_ENABLED], process.PROCESS_DESC as [process!1!PROCESS_DESC], process.AUTHOR_ID as [process!1!AUTHOR_ID], process.VERSION as [process!1!VERSION], process.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_ID as [process!1!EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_ID], process.PROCESS_TYPE_ID as [process!1!PROCESS_TYPE_ID], process.RESPONSIBLE_PARTICIPANT_ID as [process!1!RESPONSIBLE_PARTICIPANT_ID], process.ROOT_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID as [process!1!ROOT_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID], NULL as [activity!2!ACTIVITY_DEFINITION_ID], NULL as [activity!2!ACTIVITY_DESC], NULL as [activity!2!ACTIVITY_IMPLEMENTATION_ID], NULL as [activity!2!SUB_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID], NULL as [activity!2!LOOP_CONDITION!xmltext], NULL as [activity!2!PRIORITY], NULL as [activity!2!START_MODE_ID], NULL as [activity!2!FINISH_MODE_ID], NULL as [activity!2!AUTOMATED_CLASS_NAME], NULL as [activity!2!TRANSITION_RESTRICtION_ID], NULL as [activity!2!WORK_ITEM_LIMIT], NULL as [activity!2!REQUIRED_WORK_ITEM_COUNT], NULL as [activity!2!REQUIRED_ANCESTOR_COUNT], NULL as [activity!2!TIME_LIMIT], NULL as [activity!2!CLIENT_STATUS_MSG_XML], NULL as [activity!2!TIME_EXPIRED_ACTIVITY_ID], NULL as [transIn!3!TRANSITION_ID], NULL as [transIn!3!TRANSITION_DESC], NULL as [transIn!3!TO_ACTIVITY_ID], NULL as [transIn!3!TRANSITION_TYPE_ID], NULL as [transIn!3!CONDITIONS!xmltext], NULL as [transIn!3!FROM_ACTIVITY_ID], NULL as [transOut!4!TRANSITION_ID], NULL as [transOut!4!TRANSITION_DESC], NULL as [transOut!4!TO_ACTIVITY_ID], NULL as [transOut!4!TRANSITION_TYPE_ID], NULL as [transOut!4!CONDITIONS!xmltext], NULL as [transOut!4!FROM_ACTIVITY_ID]
From LU_Process_definition process
UNION ALL
Select 2 as Tag, 1 as Parent, process.PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID , process.IS_TEAM_ENABLED, process.PROCESS_DESC, process.AUTHOR_ID, process.VERSION, process.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_ID, process.PROCESS_TYPE_ID, process.RESPONSIBLE_PARTICIPANT_ID, process.ROOT_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID, activity.ACTIVITY_DEFINITION_ID, activity.ACTIVITY_DESC, activity.ACTIVITY_IMPLEMENTATION_ID, activity.SUB_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID, activity.LOOP_CONDITION, activity.PRIORITY, activity.START_MODE_ID, activity.FINISH_MODE_ID, activity.AUTOMATED_CLASS_NAME, activity.TRANSITION_RESTRICTION_ID, activity.WORK_ITEM_LIMIT, activity.REQUIRED_WORK_ITEM_COUNT, activity.REQUIRED_ANCESTOR_COUNT, activity.TIME_LIMIT, activity.CLIENT_STATUS_MSG_XML, activity.TIME_EXPIRED_ACTIVITY_ID, NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL, NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL FROM LU_Process_definition process Inner Join LU_Activity_definition Activity on process.Process_DEFINITION_ID=Activity.Process_DEFINITION_ID
UNION ALL
Select 3 as Tag, 2 as Parent, process.PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID , process.IS_TEAM_ENABLED, process.PROCESS_DESC, process.AUTHOR_ID, process.VERSION, process.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_ID, process.PROCESS_TYPE_ID, process.RESPONSIBLE_PARTICIPANT_ID, process.ROOT_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID, activity.ACTIVITY_DEFINITION_ID, activity.ACTIVITY_DESC, activity.ACTIVITY_IMPLEMENTATION_ID, activity.SUB_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID, activity.LOOP_CONDITION, activity.PRIORITY, activity.START_MODE_ID, activity.FINISH_MODE_ID, activity.AUTOMATED_CLASS_NAME, activity.TRANSITION_RESTRICTION_ID, activity.WORK_ITEM_LIMIT, activity.REQUIRED_WORK_ITEM_COUNT, activity.REQUIRED_ANCESTOR_COUNT, activity.TIME_LIMIT, activity.CLIENT_STATUS_MSG_XML, activity.TIME_EXPIRED_ACTIVITY_ID, transIn.TRANSITION_ID, transIn.TRANSITION_DESC, transIn.TO_ACTIVITY_ID, transIn.TRANSITION_TYPE_ID, transIn.CONDITION, transIn.FROM_ACTIVITY_ID, NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL
FROM LU_Process_definition process Inner Join LU_Activity_definition Activity on process.Process_DEFINITION_ID=Activity.Process_DEFINITION_ID join LU_Transition transIn on transIn.To_Activity_Id=activity.Activity_definition_id and activity.Process_Definition_id=transIn.Process_Definition_id UNION ALL
Select 4 as Tag, 2 as Parent, process.PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID , process.IS_TEAM_ENABLED, process.PROCESS_DESC, process.AUTHOR_ID, process.VERSION, process.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_ID, process.PROCESS_TYPE_ID, process.RESPONSIBLE_PARTICIPANT_ID, process.ROOT_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID, activity.ACTIVITY_DEFINITION_ID, activity.ACTIVITY_DESC, activity.ACTIVITY_IMPLEMENTATION_ID, activity.SUB_PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID, activity.LOOP_CONDITION, activity.PRIORITY, activity.START_MODE_ID, activity.FINISH_MODE_ID, activity.AUTOMATED_CLASS_NAME, activity.TRANSITION_RESTRICTION_ID, activity.WORK_ITEM_LIMIT, activity.REQUIRED_WORK_ITEM_COUNT, activity.REQUIRED_ANCESTOR_COUNT, activity.TIME_LIMIT, activity.CLIENT_STATUS_MSG_XML, activity.TIME_EXPIRED_ACTIVITY_ID, NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL, transIn.TRANSITION_ID, transIn.TRANSITION_DESC, transIn.TO_ACTIVITY_ID, transIn.TRANSITION_TYPE_ID, transIn.CONDITION, transIn.FROM_ACTIVITY_ID FROM LU_Process_definition process Inner Join LU_Activity_definition Activity on process.Process_DEFINITION_ID=Activity.Process_DEFINITION_ID join LU_Transition transIn on transIn.from_Activity_Id=activity.Activity_definition_id and activity.Process_Definition_id=transIn.Process_Definition_id
ORDER BY [Process!1!PROCESS_DEFINITION_ID],[Activity!2!ACTIVITY_DEFINITION_ID],[transIn!3!TRANSITION_ID],[transOut!4!TRANSITION_ID] FOR XML EXPLICIT

statement.name: getStateCount
statement.sql:
select count(Current_state_ID) as Count,Current_state_id from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi with (NOLOCK)
fwi.Current_state_id in (4,5,6, 7)
Group By Current_state_id Order By Current_state_id DESC
